/***selectAllJobMstWithJobConfig***/ SELECT CAST(COUNT(A.JOB_ID) OVER() AS INTEGER) AS TOTCNT ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.JOB_ID DESC) AS rownum ,A.* ,CASE WHEN B.JOB_TYPE = 'FTP' THEN 'FTP 수신' WHEN B.JOB_TYPE = 'SFTP' THEN 'SFTP 수신' WHEN B.JOB_TYPE = 'OPENAPI' THEN 'OPENAPI 수신' WHEN B.JOB_TYPE = 'UPLOAD_WEB' THEN '파일 수동업로드' WHEN B.JOB_TYPE = 'LINK_DATA' THEN '연계데이터 가공' WHEN B.JOB_TYPE IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE B.JOB_TYPE END AS JOB_TYPE ,B.UDT_API_PARAM FROM JOB_MST A LEFT OUTER JOIN JOB_LINK_CONFIG B ON A.JOB_ID = B.JOB_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.SYS_BATCH_AT !='Y'
AND A.JOB_NM_KR LIKE '%' || #{jobNmKr} || '%'
AND (A.RECIVE_INST LIKE '%' || #{reciveSysInst} || '%' OR A.RECIVE_SYS LIKE '%' || #{reciveSysInst} || '%')
AND A.SAVE_TB_NM LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{saveTbNm}) || '%'
AND A.USE_AT LIKE '%' || #{jobUseAt} || '%'
AND B.JOB_TYPE LIKE '%' || #{jobType} || '%'
ORDER BY A.JOB_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT * FROM RDF_META_COMMON ORDER BY REG_DT DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM RDF_META_DATASET WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId}::Integer ORDER BY REG_DT DESC LIMIT 1

/***selectRdfMetaDatasetTitleList****/ SELECT B.JOB_ID, B.DCT_TITLE FROM ( SELECT JOB_ID,MAX(REG_DT) AS MAX_REG_DT FROM RDF_META_DATASET GROUP BY JOB_ID ) A, RDF_META_DATASET B WHERE A.JOB_ID=B.JOB_ID AND A.MAX_REG_DT=B.REG_DT ORDER BY JOB_ID ASC
SELECT * FROM JOB_MST A LEFT OUTER JOIN JOB_LINK_CONFIG B ON A.JOB_ID = B.JOB_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.JOB_ID=#{jobId}::Integer

SELECT JOB_ID , JOB_NM_KR , SAVE_TB_NM FROM JOB_MST WHERE 1=1
AND SAVE_TB_NM = UPPER(#{saveTbNm})
ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC

JOB_NM_KR = #{jobNmKr},
CRON_EXE_CYCLE = #{cronExeCycle},
UPDT_DT = to_char(now(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), UPDT_ID = #{userId}

UDT_API_PARAM = #{apiOptionParam},
UDT_API_FIELD_LIST = #{selectField},
WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId}::Integer
